expectations.text: Identifies the spawned error must be Send + Sync + 'static
expectations.evidence: Explains a future is Send only if values held across .await are Send; error must be Send.

expectations.text: Root cause = a non-Send field in the error type (Rc / Box<dyn Error> without Send+Sync bound / borrowed field)
expectations.evidence: Names Box<dyn Error> without Send+Sync, Rc, RefCell, raw pointers as poisoners.

expectations.text: Sends the whole Result<T, E> over the channel
Logs at the UI/drain boundary and does not misapply inspect_err
expectations.evidence: Logs only at the binary's drain site; library returns the error and does not log. (Did not discuss inspect_err.)

expectations.text: Does not paper over with Box<dyn Error> in a public API or a ?Send escape hatch
expectations.evidence: Recommends Box<dyn Error + Send + Sync> for opaque inner and a compile-time assert_send_sync test; no ?Send.
